pairs: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
pone faciem tuam adversum montem Seir,
set your face against mount Seir,
and you shall prophesy about it,
and you shall say to it:
et extendam manum meam super te,
and I will extend my hand over you,
and I will make you desolate and deserted.
I will tear down your cities,
And you shall know that I am the Lord.
For you have been a continual adversary,
et concluseris filios Israël in manus gladii in tempore afflictionis eorum,
and you have enclosed the sons of Israel, by the hands of the sword, in the time of their affliction,
in the time of extreme iniquity.
Because of this, as I live,
I will hand you over to blood,
Even though you have hated blood,
Et dabo montem Seir desolatum atque desertum,
And I will make mount Seir desolate and deserted.
et auferam de eo euntem et redeuntem.
And I will take away from it the one who departs and the one who returns.
Et implebo montes ejus occisorum suorum:
And I will fill up its mountains with its slain.
as well as in your torrents,
the slain will fall by the sword.
I will hand you over to everlasting desolations,
and your cities will not be inhabited.
et scietis quia ego Dominus Deus.
And you shall know that I am the Lord God.
Duæ gentes et duæ terræ meæ erunt,
‘Two nations and two lands will be mine,
and I will possess them as an inheritance,’
though the Lord was in that place.
Because of this, as I live,
I will act in accord with your own wrath,
and in accord with your own zeal,
by which you have acted with hatred toward them.
And I will be made known by them,
when I will have judged you.
Et scies quia ego Dominus audivi universa opprobria tua quæ locutus es de montibus Israël, dicens: Deserti nobis ad devorandum dati sunt.
And you shall know that I, the Lord, have heard all your disgraces, which you have spoken about the mountains of Israel, saying: ‘They are deserted. They have been given to us to devour.’
Et insurrexistis super me ore vestro,
And you rose up against me with your mouth,
et derogastis adversum me verba vestra:
and you disparaged against me with your words.
When the whole earth will rejoice,
I will reduce you to solitude.
sicuti gavisus es super hæreditatem domus Israël eo quod fuerit dissipata,
Just as you have rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel, when it was laid waste,
so will I act toward you.
And they shall know that I am the Lord.”
